findings.title: Terminal handoff became stale after a post-freeze material write
findings.reason: The certificate targeted material SHA 761ae7db9f0ebe2f5cf54080e57a9b1f55164b5f, while the audited PR head was 1a0fe9b106e9c98ae7684296a427e51f890975f6 after a material test commit. The result-only parent/path contract was therefore no longer valid.
findings.required_recovery: Rebuild and refreeze the terminal packet against the current material candidate, then publish a fresh result-only child.
